author: Melisa Weekley
content: I would like to believe of course there is something out there that we humans have not discovered, but the mothman is such a "big creature" how can it hide from us? It is the same as bigfoot. It is too big to hide from sight. We have cameras, drones, satellites, heat sensitive equipment, the list goes on. I do not want to discredit the reports because I do believe the people have seen something that put the fear of God in them basically. What is it? We dont know and we seem to be unable to find it.
